title: Desktop Notifications
bottom_line: Ask Claude to let you know, and it sends a macOS desktop notification through claude-notifier when your task finishes or it needs your input.

sections.heading: Ask in plain words, or type the skill's command

blocks.title: What to type
blocks.caption: The skill lists no arguments. You can also just ask, as in the examples below.

cards.title: Let me know when done
cards.text: "Let me know when this finishes" or "let me know when done".

cards.title: Ping me if stuck
cards.text: "Ping me if you get stuck" or "notify me if you get stuck".

cards.title: Ping me
cards.text: "Ping me". Claude uses the skill whenever you ask to be notified, pinged or alerted, even if you don't say claude-notifier.

blocks.text: The skill teaches Claude to call the `claude-notifier` command-line tool when a task finishes or Claude is blocked and needs your attention. It uses the tool's title, subtitle, sound, terminal and session-id flags.
No extra setup is needed beyond `claude-notifier` being installed, which the next stop covers.

sections.heading: You need a Mac with claude-notifier installed

cards.title: macOS
cards.text: The plugin is macOS-only. It sends a native macOS desktop notification.

cards.title: claude-notifier on your PATH
cards.text: The `claude-notifier` command-line tool must be installed and on `PATH`. The plugin does not install it.

blocks.title: How Claude checks for it
blocks.caption: Claude runs this before the first notification. If it prints nothing, Claude says claude-notifier is not installed and stops.

blocks.title: Nothing to configure
items: No environment variables and no plugin settings.
By default, no extra setup is needed beyond `claude-notifier` being installed.

sections.heading: By default it notifies when the task is done or blocked

blocks.title: The two default notifications
rows: The task you asked for finishes
Task done
The default sound
A one-line summary of what happened
Claude is blocked and needs your input: a decision, missing information, or a permission prompt with no response
Claude needs input
An attention sound such as `Basso` or `Ping`
A one-line summary of what is needed

blocks.title: Example: task finished
blocks.code: claude-notifier -t "Task done" -m "Build finished, all tests pass" -S default

blocks.title: Example: blocked on you
blocks.code: claude-notifier -t "Claude needs input" -m "Which auth provider should I use?" -S Ping

blocks.text: These triggers apply unless you say otherwise.

sections.heading: Say when, or with what title or sound, you want it

blocks.title: Opinionated defaults
rows: Notify when the task finishes and when Claude is blocked on you
say when you want to be notified, e.g. "only ping me if the tests fail"
Title "Task done" or "Claude needs input"; default sound when done, an alert sound such as `Ping` when blocked
ask for a different title or sound

sections.heading: These are the options a notification can carry

blocks.title: Every flag
rows: `-m, --message "text"`
Notification body (required)
`-t, --title "text"`
Title. The tool's own default is "Claude"; the skill sets "Task done" or "Claude needs input".
`-s, --subtitle "text"`
Subtitle
`-i, --session-id "id"`
Session ID for focus-on-click
`-T, --terminal "type"`
iterm2, terminal, vscode, vscodium, cursor, windsurf, zed, ghostty, warp, webstorm, intellij
`-S, --sound "sound"`
"default", "none", or a named sound (Glass, Basso, Blow, Ping, Pop, Funk, Submarine)
`-c, --claude-session-id "id"`
Claude session ID, for resolving session context

sections.heading: If no notification shows up, run claude-notifier doctor

cards.title: claude-notifier is not installed
cards.text: `command -v claude-notifier` prints nothing, so Claude says it is not installed and stops. The plugin does not install it.

cards.title: Installed, but nothing appears
cards.text: Notifications do not appear, or `claude-notifier` errors.

points.text: Run claude-notifier doctor to diagnose installation and permission problems.

next_action.text: On your next task, ask Claude: "Let me know when this finishes".
next_action.detail: This needs `claude-notifier` installed and on your PATH; if it is missing, Claude says so and stops.
